messages:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — a subset of onboarding webhook deliveries for last-night batch failed with 503s. seeing ~12 trial + low-touch accounts stalled. not an infra-wide outage but should surface to accounts with renewals in 30/60 days.

CS Bot: [alert] 503 spike detected for service: onboarding-webhooks (region: us-west-2). incident_id: INC-20260321-09.

Leo Patel: thanks for flagging. can you paste the impacted tenant IDs? i'll draft outreach once i have the list.

Maya Chen: pasted list below 👇 (abbrev): tenant_1221, tenant_77-edu, tenant-cloudx, tenant-alpha-trial. full CSV in drive: https://drive.redwood.example/incident/2612345678-impacted.csv

Ashwin Rao: root cause: regression in retry logic + throttling misclassification. retries exhausted -> upstream 503 bubbled. current mitigation: temporary rollback of retry commit + increase worker pool by 20%. ETA for full backfill: ~2.5 hours.

Julie Alvarez: that's helpful. these include 3 renewal-touch accounts (tenant-cloudx, tenant-alpha-trial, tenant_77-edu) — flagged as medium renewal risk. propose we send personalized update + offer 1-month free dedicated tokens for disruption. thoughts?

Samir Khan: agree on personalized outreach. suggest this cadence: 1) immediate 'we're aware' note, 2) follow-up after plateau with RCA + mitigation, 3) offer + enablement session if needed. keep legal/finance in loop for credit approvals.

Leo Patel: drafting immediate note now. short version for trials and low-touch: 

```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We ran into an intermittent onboarding delivery error last night that affected a subset of accounts, including yours. Our engineers have implemented a mitigation and deliveries are progressing — full completion expected within a few hours. We understand this impacts your evaluation and we apologize. We'll follow up with an RCA and a remediation plan, and we can schedule a short enablement session if it'd help.

Sincerely,
Redwood CS Team
```

Julie Alvarez: that reads well. For the three renewal-touch accounts let's add: "We will provide a one-month credit and a priority enablement session at no charge." cc: @legal, @finance.

Ashwin Rao: technical note for comms team: do not claim root-cause final until post-mortem. we can say "mitigation and initial findings indicate a retry/throttling interaction".

Maya Chen: agreed. can someone own the customer calls? Julie / Samir?

Julie Alvarez: i'll take tenant-cloudx and tenant_77-edu (high-touch). Samir — can you own tenant-alpha-trial and tenant_1221 outreach?

Samir Khan: picked up tenant-alpha-trial + tenant_1221. i'll send invites and capture feedback in this doc: https://docs.redwood.example/cs/incident-2612345678-feedback

Leo Patel: sending immediate notes now. I'll attach the short comms template for low-touch and a tailored script for renewal accounts.

CS Bot: [update] mitigation deployed by eng at 2612345690. worker_pool +20%. Rollback applied for retry logic.

Maya Chen: once eng confirms backfill complete, we'll send the RCA follow-up and log final credits. Ashwin — please paste final RCA summary when ready and confirm backfill finished.

Ashwin Rao: will post final RCA in this thread when validated. preliminary target to complete verification and backfill by 2612345722.

Julie Alvarez: capture customer commitments in Gainsight and add renewal risk tag=incident-impacted. i'll start calendar invites for enablement sessions this afternoon.

Samir Khan: collecting customer feedback post-call — will add verbatim notes to the doc and escalate any commitment impacts.

Maya Chen: thanks team. action items recap:
- Ashwin: validate backfill + post RCA (owner)
- Leo: send immediate notes (done) + comm templates (owner)
- Julie: account calls for two renewal-touch customers + enablement invites (owner)
- Samir: outreach for two trials + feedback capture (owner)
- Finance/Legal: standby for credit approvals (FYI)

We'll reconvene in ~2h or when RCA is posted. :thumbsup:
